import numpy as np

def score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx):
    """Return a 1D array of finite float priority scores (higher = merge earlier)."""
    lam = 0.95
    mu = 0.12
    w_fill = 0.28

    d0i = distance_matrix[0, i_idx]
    d0j = distance_matrix[0, j_idx]
    dij = distance_matrix[i_idx, j_idx]

    n = distance_matrix.shape[0] - 1
    s = np.mean(distance_matrix[0, 1:n + 1])
    if not np.isfinite(s) or s <= 0.0:
        s = 1.0

    savings = (d0i + d0j - lam * dij) / s
    asym = mu * np.abs(d0i - d0j) / s

    load_sum = demands[i_idx] + demands[j_idx]
    residual = np.abs(capacity - load_sum) / capacity
    fill = 1.0 - residual

    score = savings + asym + w_fill * fill
    return np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float64)
